text_block_list.text:
Here we are at the Hanshin Racecourse
today for
the spring Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Which one of these fine competitors will
walk
away with the coveted spring
shield? Narita
Taishin and Biwa
Hayahide, of the BNW trio, are
the two
to watch out for today!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
According to the report released
yesterday, the
turf should have just the
right bounce today.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And these weather conditions are similar
to when
I ran the D course last week.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
All you need to do is sit back and watch
my
winning equation in action!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
